articles.summary: Houston conference serves as a platform devoted to advancing the field of basic, preclinical, and translational cancer research Kairos Pharma, Ltd. (NYSE American: KAPA), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company addressing drug resistance in cancer, announces that Neil Bhowmick, President and Chief Scientific Officer, presents today on Kairos Pharma’s lead candidate ENV-105 and its interim efficacy results at the United Scientific Group’s 11th International Conference on Cancer Research Drug Development (Cancer RD 2026) in Houston, TX. Kairos Pharma’s current programs with ENV-105, a first-in-class CD105/BMP signaling inhibitor, include a Phase 1 trial in EGFR-driven non-small cell lung cancer and a Phase 2 trial evaluating ENV-105 (carotuximab) in combination with apalutamide in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC).
